Accessibility is something every app should strive for, but knowing what to do is often harder than actually making the accessibility changes themselves. That is why in this video I cover the top 17 must know accessibility changes that almost no one talks about. I also created a full checklist of over 80 accessibility items to check for that I use in every project.
